goals: Verify the mocked behavior of Account.containsFriend() when a friend is present.
Verify that adding a friend to a category's list correctly updates the friendMap.
activities: Mock an Account object.
Mock a DataBase object.
Initialize an empty list named friends.
Initialize an empty HashMap for friendMap.
Add the empty friends list to friendMap with key "cat".
Configure the mock Account to return true when containsFriend("nuca") is called.
Call containsFriend("nuca") on the mock Account object.
Assert that the returned value is true.
Mock an Account object.
Mock a DataBase object.
Initialize an empty list named friends.
Initialize an empty HashMap for friendMap.
Add the empty friends list to friendMap with key "cat".
Call addFriendShip on the mock DataBase with arguments "nuca", "vato", and "cat".
Retrieve the list associated with "cat" from friendMap.
Check if the retrieved list does not contain "vato".
Add "vato" to the list.
Assert that the list contains "vato".
Update friendMap with the modified list for key "cat".
Assert that the list is equal to the list retrieved from friendMap for key "cat".
